player_0.content: New plan: I prematurely concluded the exploration by issuing "DONE" while in the Gallery, failing to check if all reachable directions from the current node and previously visited nodes had been fully explored. Specifically, upon returning to the Playroom (which had available directions: north, west, east), I only took the "west" path back to the Gallery and stopped, ignoring the "north" and "east" options which might lead to unvisited rooms or confirm dead ends. Next time, I will maintain a strict set of "unexplored edges" for every visited room. Before declaring "DONE", I will verify that every room in my `nodes` list has had all its available directions traversed at least once. If I am in a room with available directions that I have not yet taken, I must take one of them instead of stopping. I will only output "DONE" when the set of unexplored directions for all known rooms is empty.
